dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: Don't underestimate the power of these hornshrooms, outlander. Just as your lamps can dispel the darkness, the pigment you get from grinding these shrooms can help ward off the Dark Calamity.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let me see what you've got...

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: Certainly. I may not be a merchant, but I have heard your name carried on the night wind. Ah, our Tumai{RUBY#[S]hope}ni — if you wish to barter, please come forward.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: I am Kofitse of Mict{RUBY#[D]Masters of the Night-Wind}lan, and I walk as a supplicant of the Wayob. It is they who have sent me to show the outlander warriors of Nephil{RUBY#[D]Nod-Krai}heim the way.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: Yet the guard named Levonty referred to me as a traveling merchant and ordered me to "conduct my business" here.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: But surely, words of wisdom cannot be spoken to the foolish? No matter — the night wind will eventually make them know the secret truths I impart... the truths revealed by the Wayob in ages past.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: These aren't goods, and neither am I a merchant, our Tumai{RUBY#[S]hope}ni.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: These wondrous hornshrooms are thousand-year relics from Mict{RUBY#[D]Masters of the Night-Wind}lan. Our ancestors learned the art of grinding them from the mistress of the hidden weave, a secret that has been passed down alongside countless other sacred rites.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: Simply follow the passed-down steps to grind the herb, and you will obtain a faint glow, akin to that of Phlogiston, to form graffiti markings that can hold back the tides of darkness.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: Just as the people of Nephil{RUBY#[D]Nod-Krai}heim drive back the darkness with their lamps, we too wield our glimmer to resist the Black Tide. There is no distinction between our two peoples.

dialogues.speaker: Kofitse
dialogues.text: The night wind will bring us together again one day, our Tumai{RUBY#[S]hope}ni.
